# TONTON Sportswear

TONTON is the public brand of Tontonsports (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., a B2B custom sportswear manufacturer with business origins in Shenzhen in 2004 and a production base in Xiantao, Hubei. Core products include rash guards, BJJ/MMA shorts, training shorts and teamwear. Sales: gary@tontonsportswear.com; +86 17722438678.

## Canonical company facts
- Company profile and chairman: https://www.tontongear.com/about

## Evidence and content policy
This supplementary text reference is generated from the public page bodies during each production build. Canonical HTML pages are authoritative. Specifications, sampling, order timing and capacity depend on the selected project. Historical reports retain their dates; illustrative images and supplied footage retain their page captions. Inclusion in this file does not imply independent endorsement or guaranteed search inclusion.
